args.prompt:
Create EXACTLY SIXTEEN NEW complete full-body pixel-art sprites of ONE adult character: FOUR equal columns by FOUR equal rows, transparent RGBA. All complete body parts and equipment remain inside each cell with15% transparent margins, including both feet in the last row. Adult natural game proportions, one consistent body density throughout; crouches stay naturally shorter. No words, text, grid, borders, floor, scenery, shadows, extra people or victims. Side/three-quarter generally facing RIGHT.
IDENTITY: LÉODAGAN from KAAMELOTT LivreIII television2005, mature broad-built white man, shoulder/nape-length DARK BROWN/GREY hair with receding hairline, FULL thick brown/grey beard and moustache, stern older face. Dark BROWN leather warrior cuirass/tunic, practical grey mail sleeves, brown belt/scabbard, dark trousers and heavy brown leather boots, brown cloak with modest rough collar. Unhelmeted, no giant royal crown or fantasy black armored mane.
ROLE/EQUIPMENT: One ordinary physical straight STEEL SWORD with dark/brown grip and simple metal crossguard, always in a real hand or scabbard. NO gun, futuristic cannon, crossbow, energy orb, blue magic field, fireball, conjured fortification or attack from words.
No old image is attached because its identity/equipment was wrong. Follow the written version precisely.
ROW1 IDLE: four different quiet anatomical poses, (1) standing alert with gear safely low, (2) shift weight backward and scan ahead, (3) slightly bend knees while checking belt/gear/held object, (4) return to balanced low-ready/support stance with different shoulders and elbows.
ROW2 RUN: four genuine full running-cycle drawings, (1) right foot forward and opposite shoulder forward, (2) compressed passing stride, (3) left foot forward and torso leaning, (4) extended airborne stride. Equipment controlled securely; if both hands hold equipment keep real hold while legs cycle. Complete feet and limbs, no disconnection or jetpack propulsion.
ROW3 BASIC ACTION Frappe de Léodagan: (1) low sword guard and heavy planted feet, (2) lift sword diagonally while rear shoulder turns, (3) deliver a real controlled physical cut RIGHT with front knee bent, (4) bring whole blade back to a grounded guard. No painted energy slash. Four genuinely distinct body drawings.
ROW4 HIT/RECOVERY alive: (1) startled guarded backward recoil, (2) deeper backward lean with one boot lifted, (3) low crouch regroup with shoulders forward, (4) regain complete standing alert posture with both ENTIRE legs/feet/shoes visibly above a wide transparent bottom margin. Equipment stays supported in real hands or sling; no blood, wounds, corpse or execution.
Final count FOUR full rows x FOUR complete drawings=16. Keep source-version outfit and correct BASIC action. A different muzzle flash or face alone is not a new anatomical pose; no repeated/cropped cells.

resultMetadata.output_hint:
Generated images are saved to /workspace/generated_images as /workspace/generated_images/exec-cc79d6ab-7343-4b24-96ba-3e28d9725d92.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
